description: The line plot illustrates the performance of five different methods—TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64—measured by minADE₂₀ (lower values indicate better performance) across varying ratios from 0.1 to 1.0. The x-axis, labeled "Ratio," is a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "minADE₂₀ (←)", is also linear, spanning from 0.60 to 0.75 with major gridlines at 0.60, 0.65, 0.70, and 0.75. The TrajICL method (blue line with circles) starts at a minADE₂₀ of approximately 0.61 and remains relatively stable, showing a slight increase to about 0.61 at a ratio of 1.0. Head Tuning (orange line with circles) begins at a high value of 0.78 and steadily decreases to approximately 0.68. FT (green line with circles) starts at 0.68 and declines sharply to around 0.60 at a ratio of 1.0. LoRA 16 (red line with circles) starts at 0.74 and decreases to about 0.61. LoRA 64 (purple line with circles) begins at 0.74 and decreases to approximately 0.61. All methods show a general trend of decreasing minADE₂₀ as the ratio increases, with FT showing the most significant improvement.
